intro: Sierra Leone has a mountainous peninsula, beaches, rainforest and inland plateaus.

chapters.title: Land
text: Freetown sits on a mountainous peninsula with white beaches. Tiwai Island is a rainforest sanctuary with many primate species. Mount Bintumani is the highest point in West Africa west of Cameroon.

chapters.title: Climate
text: Rainfall is very heavy, especially from May to October.

places.title: Landscape tour
places.intro: Places that show the variety of Sierra Leone's landscapes. The numbers match the pins on the map.
